blocks.note: Nothing in this topology is accidental: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases for the enterprise at scale, so your control owners can interrogate any number we publish.

blocks.x: The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Dataq Ledger — Industry Use Cases capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)

The build earns trust the same way every gate does: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across the Industry Use Cases estate, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.
Prove (6-10 weeks)

Under the hood this pattern runs on one rule: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read on Data, Analytics & Lakehouse programs, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)

At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline for the enterprise at scale, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.
Compound (ongoing)
The part that survives audit is the boring part: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default across the enterprise, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.
